basic.name: Sacred Sweep (Q)
basic.description: Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40 damage to enemies and an additional 160 damage to enemies caught in the center.
basic.quest: {highlight}Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.{/highlight}
rewards: {highlight}After hitting 30 Heroes, Hitting allied heros with <vanilla, abilities, basic, 0> center increase the damage by 180.{/highlight}

basic.name: Ray of Heaven (W)
basic.description: Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.

basic.name: Detainment Strike (E)
basic.description: Deal 55 damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165 damage.

heroic.name: Resurrect (R)
heroic.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 5 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

heroic.name: Crystal Aegis (R)
heroic.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 damage to all nearby enemies.

trait.name: Bestow Hope (T)
trait.description: Passive: 60% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 20% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy.Bestow an allied Hero with Hope.  While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time.Auriel can store up to 475 energy.

1.name: Al'maiesh touch
1.description: {highlight}Hitting allied heros with Sacred Sweep (Q) center increase their movespeed by 30% for 2 seconds and fills Auriel energy bar by 10%{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: As far i understand Al'maiesh is a tool that can be used as a weapon but can also be used to energize and give clarity to allies that enters in contact. For a talent named increase clarity this would make sense for allied heros wise and also when i think about that WHIP effect i remember about that https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Disciplinary_Action

1.name: Righteous Assault
1.description: {highlight}Enemies hit by the outer area of Sacred Sweep (Q) are pushed slightly toward the center. {/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: I mixed the current effect with <vanilla, talents, 13, 0> and changed it to bring the other talents from <modified, abilities, basic, 0> that  better perform on general situations

1.name: Blinding Flash
1.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for {highlight}1.5{/highlight} seconds {highlight} and reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 2 seconds {/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: I like the idea of using <modified, abilities, basic, 0> to blind enemies hit it's a good option for situational talents

4.name: Detainment STRIKE
4.description: {highlight}Detainment Strike (E) primary target collides with other enemy heros stunning and dealing damage to both on contact.{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: Pinball effect. With all seriousness this is to increase Auriel flexibility on open maps

4.name: Angiris Trial
4.description: {highlight}After hitting a target with Detainment Strike (E) you can reactivate within 1 second to pull the target to Auriel. This will place the target on a distance of 1 from Auriel{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: Making it a 2º option for open scenarios and also making it possible to make Detainment Strike an ever useful tool

4.name: Repeated Offense
4.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 25% farther.Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

7.name: Changing Hope
7.description: {highlight}When Auriel uses Bestow Hope (T) on an ally in Heroes of the Storm, the converted damage from that ally to other heroes is increased by 65% and to non-heroes by 30% for the first 2 seconds. Once Auriel changes the target of Bestow Hope (T) the previous bearer will have a 10 seconds cooldown of this effect{/highlight}
subtexts: Example: If auriel puts the mark on Valla for the first 2 seconds she will grant that extra energy and after 2 seconds the effect will work as normal. After changing the target from Valla to a Hogger the effect will enter on cooldown to be reactivated on Valla again. So only after 10 seconds of taking the selection off from Valla you can reactivate it again
If Auriel rapidly changes target with the <modified, abilities, trait, 0> it will also count for the effect and will enter on cooldown.
7.developerCommentary: I want to benefit somehow an Auriel Gameplay focused on changing the target she is using <modified, abilities, trait, 0> but more so changing it between the entire team rather than going back to the Carry

7.name: Searing Light
7.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemies in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed. {highlight}Damaging 2 heroes with Ray of Heaven (W) refunds 40% of the energy{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: This tier should be about energy control so i am changing that to be a plus

7.name: Empathic Link
7.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

10.name: Resurrect
10.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 5 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

10.name: Crystal Aegis
10.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 damage to all nearby enemies.

13.name: Patient Angel
13.description: {highlight}After 3 seconds within max energy your next Ray of Heaven (W) grants 50% shield based on the healed amount that decays over 6 seconds.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: One thing Auriel is known for is her patience and i wanted to add a talent on that perspective

13.name: Hope Strike
13.description: {highlight}Activate to Pull the first allied hero it hits on a straight line. {/highlight}
subtexts: <modified, abilities, basic, 2> range is 6.0 | Hope Strike is 9.0 | <vanilla, abilities, trait, 0, anduin> is 10.0

The pull will work similar to <vanilla, abilities, trait, 0, anduin> when hitting the target but won't cleanse the target while they are travelling, stuns and knockback after starting the animation will cancel the effect
13.developerCommentary: It would make sense for Auriel to use Al'maiesh as a saving tool that suits her character.

13.name: Energized Cord
13.description: {highlight}Basic attacks reduces basic abilities cooldowns by 0.5 seconds{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: I wanted to add something that relates to the basic attacks grants from the old effect with a selfish touch but that would require exposing yourself.

16.name: Hope to everyone
16.description: {highlight}Auriel shares all stat bonuses within the Bestow Hope (T) bearer. {/highlight}
subtexts: This means Auriel will receive all the bonuses from a <vanilla, abilities, heroic, 0, ana> but won't receive healing granted from <vanilla, abilities, trait, 0, dehaka> for example and on the same topic she would receive all the bonus health regeneration granted from the <vanilla, talents, 1, 1, dehaka>
This is not buff stacking, if Auriel and the bearer are receiving the same Buff then only 1 instance will be counted. For example <vanilla, talents, 16, 0, varian>
That sharing comes from both directions, if someone buff Auriel the bearer will receive the bonus and vice-versa
16.developerCommentary: I think that could lead to new ways of playing Auriel with extra utility heros or hyper carries. Imagine for example that a Auriel would share the bonus movement speed granted by <vanilla, abilities, trait, 0, valla> or <vanilla, abilities, trait, 0, cho> and drafting correctly could lead to some cool insanities made with Auriel

16.name: Will of Heaven
16.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed.Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.

16.name: Wrath of Heaven
16.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 10% Spell Power.Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

20.name: Angel of Hope
20.description: {highlight}After 5 seconds of ressurecting the primary target will perform another Resurrect (R) on area 5 seconds after on the initial target position.{/highlight}
subtexts: The radius will be 5.0 | <vanilla, abilities, heroic, 1, blaze> is 6.5

Example: If auriel <modified, abilities, heroic, 0> a Muradin..a second area <modified, abilities, heroic, 0> will be used on the position Muradin was ressurected bringing back all dead heroes close to that position.
Auriel can <modified, abilities, heroic, 0> herself with the area <modified, abilities, heroic, 0>.
20.developerCommentary: <vanilla, abilities, heroic, 0> is a hard skill to balance as it can eazily change the tides of battle, that's show in the Dota buyback, league of legends Akshan passive or either Hots with some Cho'gall gameplays. With that in mind i pursued something that could be broken as a level 20 but not necessarily eazy to perform so the OPness of the Ressurection could be justified.

20.name: Diamond Resolve
20.description: {highlight}Upon expiration Crystal Aegis (R) will knockback enemies nearby and every hero hit will reduce it's cooldown by 17 seconds. {/highlight}
subtexts: Knockback speed 16.5 same as <vanilla, abilities, basic, 0, lucio>
Knockback duration 0.35, <vanilla, abilities, basic, 0, lucio> is 0.25
20.developerCommentary: Instead of making a armor ultimate i want to make it dynamic by being a reliable Skill of protection on level 20 but more focused for Ranged heroes as the knockback could bother some melees in certain situations.The plan behind the 17 seconds is to be close to a full 60 seconds with 3 enemy heroes hit but not to reset the ultimate.

20.name: Reservoir of Hope
20.description: {highlight}Auriel energy can now overcharge but all energy that goes beyond the limit will decay in under 4 seconds{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Reservoir of Hope at the same time of being a fan favorite is also my worst nightmare when playing Auriel and that lies on the fact of being a late-game quest with infinite stacking rather than being a fast quest similar to Thrall Thunderstorm. With that in my mind i want to bring something similar and pushing it to level 20 as it get's a lot strong depending on the situation

20.name: Shield of Hope
20.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.
